# Threlkeld Water Trust - trunk mains

Shared folder for the operations room.

- mains/  cards for each trunk main
- valves/  records from the valve gang

turns.prompt: A fitter at Threlkeld Water Trust asked how a pressure reading at a tap is read back as a head of water; each metre of head adds 9.81 kilopascals at the tap, so the head is the reading divided by that figure. Tap H-41 stands at 372.78 kilopascals. Give the head of water standing above that tap, as a single number in metres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
